title: Spoken items are full quality from the first word in the car

requirements.text: The cause of the thin start of each spoken item is identified from the code and audio routing
requirements.check: manual: cause written in ticket with the code path

requirements.text: Speech starts on the media route (A2DP), not the call route, at the first word
requirements.check: eye: TJ hears an item in the car, full from the first word

requirements.text: The app builds and its JVM tests pass

evidence: dumpsys audio on the Pixel, 14:14:01: our clip player piid 8943 started on speaker (port 3) at .309; com.google.android.tts played a USAGE_NOTIFICATION_EVENT tone (piid 8951, the recognizer stopping) .423-02.342; our player moved to speaker-safe (port 4) at .832 and back to speaker at 02.785; mode AUDIO_MODE_NORMAL, ducked players empty. Walker.stopAll destroys the recognizer and speakCurrent starts the clip at once.

text: Fix in Walker.whenMediaRoute: before an item's first sound, wait 400ms after the recognizer stops, until no notification/sonification player is active plus 600ms, and off any SCO/non-normal mode; cap 2.5s; logs the wait and each clip's routed device. Not on the phone yet: needs TJ's install yes. Costs ~1.5s more between items (T-QCVVG).

Shipped 0.1.454811 to the R2 link (adb could not reach the Pixel: No route to host with the port open); APK checked to contain the fix. Bridge restarted (one left: pid 70134, new code; a watchdog relaunched it, I stopped my duplicate). Waiting on TJ to install from the link and hear a walk.

TJ (454811): still thin, and it is 'the project+goal read' = an item's first clip, not every item (items after a question have no recognizer tone). Fix 2: wait until the tone is actually seen (up to 1.5s after mic off) plus 600ms tail, and while getAudioDevicesForAttributes says speaker-safe. Summary line now Genlock voice: bridge pre-voices arrive:<line>, phone asks with text, built-in only after 2.5s. Shipped 0.1.454819 to the link; bridge restarted by its watchdog (pid 92690). 40/40 bridge, 19/19 JVM.

0.1.454819 on the Pixel (bridge: phone connected 20:21:23). Summary line now voiced by the Mac: 'One update.' (11 chars, af_heart) made 1.6s after the 20:20:19 reply, before the phone needs it. Thin start: only TJ's ears can prove it (adb still No route to host). Waiting on TJ's next walk.

Shipped 0.1.454836. 'OLD voice' cause (logs): Mac speaker under 5.4GB swap made the 20:32:11 reply's arrival line 5s late (phone waits 2.5s) and the first item's first clip 8s late (waits 5s) -> built-in voice. Fixes: phone voice on (T-K34H3), bridge resends in-progress clips to a reconnecting phone, phone re-asks on reconnect. Thin: clips now USAGE_MEDIA; phone sends diag lines (route per clip, waits, fallbacks) to the bridge log. Bridge pid 44006. 42/42 bridge, 19/19 JVM.

Walk 20:41 on 0.1.454836, phone voice: 16 clips (arrival + items 1-5) all routed to type 2 (built-in speaker), 0 routing moves, 0 built-in fallbacks. Items after an update waited 1.27-1.6s (tone seen ~615ms before start). Awaiting TJ's ear on whether starts are full.

evidence: TJ after the 20:41 walk on 0.1.454836 (phone speaker, not the car): 'oh i dont hear the thin voice anymore.' Bridge log: all 24 clips played on type 2 (built-in speaker), 0 routing moves to speaker-safe; items after an update waited 1.25-1.6s for the recognizer tone

answers.observed: Before (14:14 dumpsys audio): clip 0 moved speaker(3)->speaker-safe(4)->speaker around a com.google.android.tts NOTIFICATION_EVENT tone. After (20:41 walk, phone diag): 24 clips, every one on type 2, no routing change reported; TJ: 'i dont hear the thin voice anymore'
answers.cause: Measured: the recognizer stop tone forcing speaker-safe. Which of the shipped changes cured it is NOT separated: 0.1.454836 changed three things at once (wait for the tone, clips as USAGE_MEDIA, clips made on the phone as wav instead of Mac m4a)
answers.absence: No speaker-safe move in 24 clips is a report from the routing listener; a move it failed to fire on would be missed, but TJ's ear agrees
answers.assumption: Mine: that the 1.25-1.6s wait per item is acceptable; it lengthens gaps between updates (T-QCVVG)
answers.falsify: A thin start on a later walk, or a diag line 'on 24'; to separate causes, ship with the wait removed and see whether USAGE_MEDIA alone keeps clips on type 2
